title: Good engineering
*is felt, not just seen.*
statement: I believe technology should be invisible, intuitive and human. Performance, accessibility and maintainability are not checkboxes — they are part of a better, more inclusive web.
statementMobile: Technology should feel invisible, intuitive and human—built for performance, accessibility and maintainability.

principles.title: Performance
principles.body: Optimize for speed, Core Web Vitals and real user experience — not just lab scores.
principles.short: Optimize for speed, Core Web Vitals and real user experience.

principles.title: Accessibility
principles.body: Build experiences that are inclusive, usable and work for more people, across devices and contexts.
principles.short: Build inclusive experiences across devices and contexts.

principles.title: Maintainability
principles.body: Write clean, modular code and scalable systems that support long-term growth.
principles.short: Write clean, modular code and scalable systems.
